method: zh-CN fit probe: Chinese renders in 2-cell CJK glyphs and is normally shorter than English, so no RTL-style synthetic stretch is meaningful. measured_cells is the authoritative cell count (East Asian Wide/Fullwidth = 2, combining marks = 0). A +25% growth scenario models a future longer phrasing for the same key; it is reported but not treated as a failure. This is a synthetic fit probe, not a rendered TUI screenshot.
